recommended_next_step.representation: Immutable M4 carriers are topology leaves. Their many-to-one kernel supports consume no additional degree. Recover nearest-endpoint ports using original host ordering and argmin ties. Use successful-fit cost residual_max+tangent_max/30, never candidate-ranking cost.
fixed_graph.unknown: Both arms exclude pairs in the saved full joint ambiguity mask; retain them as alternatives and disclose this conservative limitation. Valid dormant UNKNOWN carriers remain graph vertices. Invalid/frozen carriers cannot gain links. No new fits, candidates or thresholds.
fixed_graph.contexts: Priority seeds: exact M4 contributors of saved M5 groups53254 and210790; four saved negative pairs84842/362883,153248/377058,153427/153430,301451/301459. Add at most two remaining feasible endpoint components with>=3 leaves, ranked leaf count descending then minimum ID.
fixed_graph.closure: Close each seed over ALL successful endpoint candidates before ambiguity exclusion; include every incident saved overlap/rejected candidate and its complete endpoint carrier rows as context. Merge intersecting contexts and repeat closure. Cap128 total carriers/context; oversized contexts remain NOT_RUN, never trim competitors. Freeze selection before either arm runs. Saved neighborhoods are complete only relative to the capped v05 proposal list; preserve saturation/cap limitations.

paired_arms.baseline: Descending benefit then canonical carrier/port IDs; accept if both ports free and resulting complete path passes all shared guards.
paired_arms.joint: scipy.optimize.milp binary variable per eligible endpoint link. Minimize sum(cost*x)+number_of_unmatched_ports; equivalently maximize sum((2-cost)*x). Each port<=1 link; no cycles. Empty selection is feasible. Canonical variable ordering; do not perturb scientific costs for ties.
paired_arms.whole_path: Orient unchanged leaf q; connectors exist only for checking, carry zero observed support and are never rendered. Check joined tangent30deg/connector35deg/gap1.5p, vertex turn30deg, every8p cumulative turn60deg, nonadjacent contact0.5p, original parallel and three-arm predicates over complete path membership, and unsupported gap1.5p. Preserve local leaf residual/tangent validity; do not impose a new single-carrier union fit.
paired_arms.cuts: For MILP solutions violating a cycle or whole-path guard, add a no-good cut excluding that selected path's edge set and resolve. Same guard oracle for greedy. At most32 solve/check rounds per context,120s cumulative solver time/context, total solver budget600s; mip_rel_gap=0. Preserve status,bound,gap and cuts. Only a checked feasible incumbent may be exported; timeout is PARTIAL, never claimed optimal.
paired_arms.membership: Preserve incumbent rows/groups; new path ID=min constituent carrier ID with versioned lineage. Outside processed contexts retain M4 IDs. Dormant rows activate only with existing3-seedlet/6-kernel/4p deduplicated-support gate; otherwise remain UNKNOWN with proposed association recorded. All identities provisional.

changed_variable.versus_v05: Composite identity can contain several unchanged finite carriers and connect both ports in one unit. This jointly changes representation and association; it is not merely adding polyline support or equivalent acceleration.

falsification.visual: Joint must improve visibly coherent cross-fragment identity over greedy without swallowing distinct parallel/depth structures or branches. Lower objective, more links or common color alone are insufficient. Missing visible curved continuation remains PARTIAL.
falsification.delivery: No completed tracer without cold-reloaded full-row mappings and both actual full views. Geometry changes, lost incumbent rows, split incumbent groups or rendered unsupported bridges fail immediately.
falsification.continuation: If candidate coverage, overlap representation or the retained ambiguity mask removes the useful continuations, log that specific bottleneck and propose a separately frozen redesign next.
